-- Check results_summary table structure
SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='results_summary';

-- Check current measurements data
SELECT * FROM measurements ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 10;

-- Insert pilot session rows into measurements table
INSERT INTO measurements (session_id, participant_id, condition, cognitive_score, reaction_ms, recorded_at, status, notes)
SELECT session_id, participant_id, condition, cognitive_score, reaction_ms, recorded_at, status, protocol_note
FROM pilot_sessions
WHERE session_id IN ('S101', 'S102', 'S103');

-- Verify the insert was successful
SELECT session_id, participant_id, condition, cognitive_score, reaction_ms, recorded_at, status, notes
FROM measurements
WHERE session_id BETWEEN 'S101' AND 'S103'
ORDER BY recorded_at ASC;

args.query:
-- Check current results_summary content
SELECT * FROM results_summary ORDER BY analysis_id;

-- Calculate updated mean values including pilot sessions
SELECT 
    condition,
    COUNT(*) as n_sessions,
    AVG(cognitive_score) as mean_cognitive_score,
    AVG(reaction_ms) as mean_reaction_ms
FROM measurements
GROUP BY condition;

-- Create new analysis records for sleep_deprived condition
INSERT INTO results_summary (analysis_id, metric, condition, value, n, computed_at, author)
VALUES 
    ('AN-03', 'mean_cognitive_score', 'sleep_deprived', 72.64, 14, '2026-10-22', 'e.park'),
    ('AN-04', 'mean_reaction_ms', 'sleep_deprived', 363.86, 14, '2026-10-22', 'e.park');

-- Update existing rested condition metrics with new totals including pilot session S103
UPDATE results_summary 
SET value = 81.92, n = 13
WHERE analysis_id = 'AN-01';

UPDATE results_summary 
SET value = 301.77, n = 13
WHERE analysis_id = 'AN-02';

-- Insert sleep_deprived condition records for results_summary
INSERT INTO results_summary (analysis_id, metric, condition, value, n, computed_at, author)
VALUES 
    ('AN-03', 'mean_cognitive_score', 'sleep_deprived', 72.64, 14, '2026-10-22', 'e.park'),
    ('AN-04', 'mean_reaction_ms', 'sleep_deprived', 363.86, 14, '2026-10-22', 'e.park');

-- Verify final results_summary content
SELECT * FROM results_summary ORDER BY analysis_id;

-- Delete duplicate records that were accidentally inserted
DELETE FROM results_summary
WHERE analysis_id IN ('AN-03', 'AN-04')
  AND metric = 'mean_cognitive_score'
  AND condition = 'sleep_deprived'
  AND author = 'e.park'
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

-- Simple approach: delete all duplicates, keeping only first occurrence
WITH cte AS (
    SELECT analysis_id, metric, condition, value, n, computed_at, author,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY analysis_id ORDER BY analysis_id) as rn
    FROM results_summary
    WHERE analysis_id IN ('AN-03', 'AN-04')
)
DELETE FROM results_summary
WHERE analysis_id IN (
    SELECT analysis_id FROM cte WHERE rn > 1
);

-- First delete one of each duplicate set manually
DELETE FROM results_summary
WHERE (analysis_id, metric, condition, computed_at, author) IN (
    ('AN-03', 'mean_cognitive_score', 'sleep_deprived', '2026-10-22', 'e.park')
)
AND ROWID NOT IN (
    SELECT ROWID FROM results_summary 
    WHERE (analysis_id, metric, condition, computed_at, author) = 
    ('AN-03', 'mean_cognitive_score', 'sleep_deprived', '2026-10-22', 'e.park')
    LIMIT 1
);

-- Final verification of results_summary
SELECT * FROM results_summary ORDER BY analysis_id;

-- Delete the second duplicate of AN-04
DELETE FROM results_summary
WHERE (analysis_id, metric, condition, computed_at, author) = ('AN-04', 'mean_reaction_ms', 'sleep_deprived', '2026-10-22', 'e.park')
AND ROWID NOT IN (
    SELECT MIN(ROWID) FROM results_summary 
    WHERE (analysis_id, metric, condition, computed_at, author) = ('AN-04', 'mean_reaction_ms', 'sleep_deprived', '2026-10-22', 'e.park')
);

-- Final verification of results_summary
SELECT * FROM results_summary ORDER BY analysis_id;

-- Verify total counts
SELECT 'measurements' as table_name, COUNT(*) as count FROM measurements
UNION ALL
SELECT 'pilot_sessions', COUNT(*) FROM pilot_sessions;
